cost_ledger.scope: Static operation counts, not measured 1024-DINO wall time

m01.operation: same-role conditional three-point retrieval and independent-bank control

m02.operation: three shared BG-hypothesis full replays, method/point-naive/refund-only controls

m03.operation: reference-only split-cost CV and query full average-linkage tree DP; N squared transient distance

m04.operation: bounded part hypotheses, occlusion/tree messages, source seed-prior replay

m05.operation: aligned/native-box new paired views; method/naive share their view contexts

m06.operation: up to three source clusters, independent prior maxima, naive and K1 identity

m07.operation: four spatially heldout BG banks, deterministic four-mode fitting and no-holdout control

m08.operation: three-layer chunked shared/late/concat correspondence; no N squared disk cache

m10.operation: three extra phases, support-only monotone calibration, shift-average/inverse share observations

cost_ledger.time_policy: No real timing exists. After explicit GPU authorization, use first-case per-arm encoder/decode/solver clocks to judge whether remaining cases fit 1800s; do not use query GT to change budget or parameters.

stopping: A shared native/cache identity failure stops the stage; each mechanism error is saved and does not cancel independent methods. No automatic retries/sweeps.
